summary: SiteDocument represents documents associated with a Site, primarily linking a document by ID and SiteID in the data layer.
purpose: The purpose is to provide a model for storing and retrieving documents associated with particular sites within the system.
system_behavior: Documents are associated with sites through SiteID.
SiteDocument entity is used in the DataLayer for linking and storing.

summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin implements a user interface for staff administrators, featuring date filters, site and discipline dropdowns, application status, email and program display, and error/warning handling.
purpose: Provides a welcome dashboard for staff admin users, allowing them to filter and view submitted employment applications, error/warning status, and interact with UI controls.

workflows.name: Employment Applications Filter and View
steps: Set default date filters (start date: now minus 3 months, end date: today).
Error and warning panels show messages as necessary.

business_rules: Date filters must be valid and start date must not be after end date.
Withdrawn applications can be toggled for visibility.
Applications display relevant status and withdrawal dates.
validations: Required field validation for date fields.
Regular expression validation for date input format.
conditions: RefreshData is triggered on filter changes.
Show/hide error or warning panels based on system state.
system_behavior: Registers JavaScript for date functions and admin-specific actions.
Displays error/warning panels and validation summaries.
dependencies: Dropdowns depend on Lists of Sites and Disciplines.
UserSession for agency context and filtering.
exceptions: If UserSession is null, data selection is cancelled.
If invalid dates are provided, validation fails.

summary: ServiceCode is a data entity representing a service code, including its category, name, alt name, notes, and sort order. It is used for organizing and referencing codes in courses, timetables, and service lists.
purpose: To store and manage service codes for various operational needs such as course assignment, timetable options, and code categorization within the system.

workflows.name: Fetch Service Codes
steps: ServiceCodeListAll procedure retrieves a list of all service codes.
ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID and ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID procedures retrieve codes filtered by CourseID or TimetableID.

business_rules: If UseAltLanguageFields is enabled, use alternate language fields for display.
conditions: UseAltLanguageFields determines which Name and Notes are shown.
system_behavior: ServiceCode entities are fetched and localized based on session context and filters.

summary: SiteProfileHistory records changes to Site profiles, including fields changed, actions taken, user details, agency, and formatted outputs for audit and display.
purpose: Track and display historical changes to Site profiles, showing who made changes, when they were made, and what was modified for audit and transparency.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the history entry

fields.name: ByUserID
fields.description: ID of user who performed the action

workflows.name: Site Profile History Search
steps: SiteProfileHistorySearch retrieves history entries by SiteID, SessionAgencyID, and session context.
History entries are formatted for display and auditing with user details and agency.

business_rules: If user is not sysadmin and ByUserID differs from ByOriginalUserID, add support team caption to output.
Display user details along with agency and user initials.
calculations: FormatName, FormatDateShort, and TooltipDetails produce formatted outputs.
system_behavior: Records and displays history of changes to site profiles.
exceptions: If UserSession is null, selection is cancelled.

summary: EmailPopupDocument provides a model for managing popup email attachments, including file details and the ability to delete files and folders.
purpose: Enable email popup attachments to be searched, listed, and deleted, managing associated files and folders on the system.

workflows.name: Attachment Search and Delete
steps: Search splits data info strings into file entries.
Delete removes specified file and folder by ID.

system_behavior: Files can be deleted only if their paths exist.
Folders are deleted after file removal.
exceptions: Deleting non-existent files/folders safely handles exceptions.

summary: CostCentre and CostCentreRecord provide models and data layer for retrieving and displaying placement cost centre information, including agencies, sites, disciplines, dates, and cost centre metrics.
purpose: To track and report placement-related costs and metrics across agencies, disciplines, sites, departments, and more for financial and operational analysis.

workflows.name: Get Cost Centre Records
steps: GetCostCentre method retrieves records filtered by session, date, agency, discipline, site, service, destination, and PR status.
Records returned include metrics for cost centres.

system_behavior: Reads placement cost centre data and closes database reader after operation.
